playstyle.identity: Kayn is a transforming jungler who becomes either Shadow Assassin (burst) or Rhaast (drain tank) based on who he fights. He walks through walls and adapts to the game.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive transforms based on combat (ranged = assassin, melee = Rhaast). Q dashes and damages. W slows (Rhaast knocks up). E walks through terrain and heals. R dives into an enemy, becoming untargetable. Choose form based on enemy comp.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Kayn spikes when he transforms. Shadow Assassin bursts squishies. Rhaast sustains through tanks. He's strong after transformation.

passive.name: The Darkin Scythe
passive.summary: Fighting ranged grants Shadow Assassin; fighting melee grants Rhaast form.
passive.details: Kayn builds bars by fighting champions. Ranged champions build blue (Shadow Assassin), melee build red (Rhaast). First full bar allows transformation.

abilities.name: Reaping Slash
abilities.summary: Dash and spin, dealing damage twice.
abilities.details: Kayn dashes and spins his scythe, dealing damage twice. Can pass through thin walls.

abilities.name: Blade's Reach
abilities.summary: Slash forward dealing damage and slowing. Rhaast: also knocks up.
abilities.details: Kayn slashes in a line, damaging and slowing enemies. As Rhaast, this ability also knocks enemies up.

abilities.name: Shadow Step
abilities.summary: Walk through terrain gaining movement speed and healing.
abilities.details: Kayn gains movement speed and can walk through terrain. He heals the first time he enters terrain.

abilities.name: Umbral Trespass
abilities.summary: Dive into an enemy champion, becoming untargetable, then burst out.
abilities.details: Kayn infests an enemy champion, becoming untargetable inside them. After a few seconds or on recast, he bursts out dealing damage. Rhaast heals based on target max health.
